description: This PHP file defines the 'InterviewAttachmentsController' class, responsible for managing the attachment view for interviews within the Recruitment plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to prepare the component for rendering interview attachments and to check user permissions.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentsController
classes.description: Controller responsible for rendering the interview attachments view and checking user permissions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the attachments component with interview data, maximum file size, and allowed file types for rendering.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to the specified interview based on permissions.
